answer: Cedar-milestone bond: each identity stakes 70 credits on a cedar ledger and clears three milestones: verified work, peer review, thirty days of activity. Each milestone earns a saffron stamp; auditors replay them, and a forged or rented milestone burns the bond and sinks the identity to nadir. First costs 42, the k-th 42+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,038,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 42 once and keep their bond.
